title: Count the digits
prompt: Return how many digits the number n has. n is never negative, and 0 counts as one digit. solve(12345) is 5.
hints: Dividing a whole number by 10 drops its last digit: 123 / 10 is 12.
Handle 0 first, then `while n > 0:` divide and count.

docs.name: while condition:
docs.what: Repeats the indented lines below it as long as the condition stays true.
